name: How long does a full kitchen remodel usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen remodel usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most full kitchen remodels take between six to twelve weeks of active construction once site work begins. The total timeline expands if you include the pre-construction phase, which involves design drafting, material selections, and local building permits. Factors that extend construction duration include moving gas lines, relocating load-bearing walls, or waiting on custom cabinetry with extended lead times. Having all appliances, fixtures, and tile selected and ordered before demolition helps prevent mid-project delays and keeps subcontractors on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Active construction typically takes six to twelve weeks, though planning, permitting, and material procurement add extra time before demolition starts.
